# Production

Stock `mes.production.*` screens: Equipment Manager, Value Editor, Analysis, Material Manager.

## Why "Production" components show up outside the Production menu too

This gateway has one combined **Production module** installed (`Production-module.modl`), which actually bundles Batch Procedure, Document Phase, OEE, Settings & Changeover, and SPC together with the core Production/equipment-model components. Track & Trace is the only separately-installed add-on (`Trace-module.modl`). Because of that, a component's Perspective type namespace doesn't line up with which menu section it lives in here - components are placed in this starter by what they're used *for*, not by which module owns their namespace.

Two components in particular turn up all over the other modules' screens, each menu section instantiating its own copy:

- **`mes.production.mesEquipmentManager`** - the same Equipment Manager screen appears in every module's menu (Production, OEE, Batch, Settings & Changeover, SPC, Trace), not just here. It's the same component and the same underlying equipment model every time, just reachable from wherever a module needs it.
- **`mes.production.mesObjectSelector`** - the equipment/location picker. Nearly every screen across every module has its own instance, each one scoped to whatever level of the equipment model that screen cares about.

`mes.production.batchSelector` (the Batch ID picker) is the exception - it's only used within the Batch section (Batch Controller, Recipe Monitor, EBR Viewer), not reused elsewhere.
